en.headline: Official voter roll lists 4.12 million geographical electors
en.dek: The 2026 final registers published today record 4,116,965 geographical constituency electors, about 22,000 fewer than a year earlier, the Registration and Electoral Office said.
body: The Registration and Electoral Office published the 2026 final registers of electors and voters on Friday, listing 4,116,965 people on the geographical constituency roll.

A spokesman for the office said the functional constituency register carries 182,359 individual electors and 8,489 corporate electors, a combined 190,848. The Election Committee subsector voter register lists 3,448 individual voters and 5,894 corporate voters, or 9,342 in total.

Now TV reported the geographical figure is about 22,000 lower than a year earlier. Electors and voters can check their own entries through iAM Smart or the voter registration website. Statistical tables for the final registers have been posted on that site.

zh.headline: 正式選民登記冊發表 地方選區411萬6965人
zh.dek: 選舉事務處今日發表2026年正式選民及投票人登記冊，地方選區載有411萬6965名選民，較去年約少2.2萬人。
body: 選舉事務處今日發表2026年地方選區、功能界別及選舉委員會界別分組正式選民／投票人登記冊。發言人表示，地方選區正式選民登記冊載有411萬6965名選民。
功能界別正式選民登記冊載有18萬2359名個人選民及8489名團體選民，合共19萬848名。選委會界別分組正式投票人登記冊則載有3448名個人投票人及5894名團體投票人，合共9342名。
Now新聞台報道，地方選區選民人數按年減少約2.2萬人。選民及投票人可透過「智方便」或選民登記網站查閱本人登記資料，正式登記冊的統計數字亦已上載至該網站。
